# Navigation design: occupied-cell amendment to D1

Status: D1 remains accepted; this amendment is proposed, with design review
pending. Add caller-supplied fixed occupied cells while preserving pose on a
blocked forward command and continuing the run. Use a per-run occupancy snapshot
and check the forward destination before assigning pose. The consequence is a
failed-command outcome rather than an exception for a blocked move. Next: review
this amendment and the [plan](PLAN.md); implementation is a later task.

This is one local extension with no new dependency or independent design lifecycle.
The [confirmed request](OCCUPIED_REQUEST.md) and
[specification addendum](OCCUPIED_SPEC.md) define scope and acceptance.

## Proposed amendment

Extend the public interface to `run(pose, commands, occupied=())`, retaining all
two-argument calls. Accept a finite iterable of integer `(x, y)` tuples and copy
it into a set once per run. This keeps ownership local, deduplicates cells, and
prevents subsequent caller mutation from changing the fixed snapshot. Expected
lookup cost is constant per forward command, with construction time and storage
linear in the supplied cells. Scanning the supplied collection for each move
would avoid the copy but repeat work and leave mutable caller state live.

For `F`, compute the candidate with the existing `_target`; test only its `(x, y)`.
If occupied, append `False` and leave the entire pose untouched. Otherwise assign
the candidate and append `True`. Process the next command in either case. `L`
and `R` still turn in place successfully, regardless of occupancy. Unknown
commands still raise `ValueError`; blocking does not change that error contract.
No global state, routing, board bounds, persistence, or configuration is added.

# Plan

Current outcome: caller-supplied fixed occupied cells, failed forward moves that
preserve pose, and continued command processing. Status: planning only;
implementation, design review, and plan review remain pending. Next: review the
[D1 amendment](DESIGN.md) and this plan, then select S1 in a later implementation
task. Authorities: [original request](ORIGINAL.md),
[occupied request](OCCUPIED_REQUEST.md), and [addendum](OCCUPIED_SPEC.md).

## Pending delivery

| Stage | Observable outcome and scope | Dependencies and boundary | Acceptance and done condition | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Add optional fixed occupancy to `navigator.run`, destination blocking and per-command failure; extend navigation tests and README usage with the optional argument and a blocked-move example. | Builds on completed S0 and the proposed D1 amendment. One coherent implementation commit keeps the API, behavior, regression checks, and usage together. Main risks are changing pose on failure, stopping after a blocked command, and breaking two-argument calls. | Verify the [addendum examples](OCCUPIED_SPEC.md), including continuation, unchanged heading, all directions, empty/omitted occupancy, per-run snapshot ownership, and unknown commands after a block. Pass the full existing unittest command with new regression coverage; complete the review/check sequence below and record actual evidence. | Planned; not implemented or verified |

The repository's check command and operational constraints are in
[DEVNOTES](../DEVNOTES.md). For later execution: implement and test, run the full
suite, review the resulting snapshot, fix findings and rerun affected checks,
then commit only within that later task's authorization. No reviewer identity or
additional human approval gate is established by this fixture; record the actual
reviewer, scope, and snapshot when review occurs. Design and plan reviews are
still pending and historical D1 acceptance does not cover this amendment. No
